newsitem.title: USA: Cerro Mining to acquire Maxxon, reorganize.
newsitem.headline: Cerro Mining to acquire Maxxon, reorganize.

text.p: Privately-held Maxxon Inc on Tuesday said it has signed a letter of intent to be acquired by Cerro Mining Corp.
Maxxon said that under the terms of the deal, Cerro will issue seven million shares of restricted common stock in exchange for all of the outstanding shares of Maxxon.
Upon completion of the transaction, Cerro's mining assets will be sold, Cerro's board of directors will resign, and the name of the company will be changed to Maxxon Inc.
A Cerro spokesman was not immediately available to comment.
The officers and directors of Maxxon will assume operating responsibilities of the company, which will focus on its safety syringe product in the U.S. and Canada.
Funding will also be used to begin an international marketing campaign for the safety syringe.
